summary_zh: E52阶段完成：共同学习外设和原话自听已落地；问答24/80，未优于不自听25/80及关Core学习31/80。只教听词的线性工具两来源各4/4，原Transformer各1/4；联想翻译仍未可靠，未修改Core默认。
summary_en: E52 phase complete: adaptive peripherals and actual self-hearing delivered. Questions score 24/80 versus 25/80 without self-hearing and 31/80 with Core plasticity off. Literal linear transcription scores 4/4 per source versus Transformer 1/4; recalled-content translation remains unreliable, with no Core/default change.
history_zh: 用户澄清，多角度是同一事物在不同句子、属性和关系中共同被指称，不只是换视角；随后明确理想表达器只负责翻译，不替意识答题，允许保留两种外设作比较。E52遂保留正在执行的共同学习教学，并增加从不给物体问答答案的词语转写对照。四个物体按颜色和形状交叉，分先教、加入新物、交换旧名三阶段；Core不改，外设继续梯度学习并有界回放，实际输出可经原感官返听。两来源主组24/80，不自听25/80，关Core可塑性31/80；虽大多教学样本可拟合，仍未获得可靠的新问题回答。由此不能把外设学到的问答直接记为Core语义。原Transformer转写各2/8，按预登记门槛停止后续阶段；在检查原始过程确有差异后，登记同资料线性转写诊断，两来源新强度听词各4/4，而Transformer同题各1/4。听词信息已到外设，失败可定位到当前读法的学习或表示，但它仍不能可靠翻译问后联想。312对不同对象活动均有区别，256对表达相同；此为测量事实，不是语义已存在的证明。同快照校准各2/12至3/12，不升为默认。可靠命名门槛未满足，本轮选择性消融与救援没有执行；E50旧通路证据保持原义。本轮340个预算计数来源阶段/探针、72.93分钟记录计算，工具、双语报告与证据独立留存，后续先定位听词、联想与表达的分布差别及输出总线观测边界，再扩大课程。
history_en: The user clarified that multiple angles means one referent constrained through different statements, properties and relations, not merely camera viewpoints. The preferred adapter should translate rather than answer on the mind's behalf, while both variants may be compared. E52 retained ongoing coadaptive teaching and added literal transcription without object-answer supervision. Four objects crossed color and shape across initial teaching, added objects and renamed objects. Core was unchanged; the peripheral continued gradient training with bounded replay and could hear its actual utterances through ordinary sensory input. Main questions scored 24/80, no self-hearing 25/80 and Core plasticity off 31/80. Mostly successful demonstration fitting did not yield reliable later answers or establish Core semantic attribution. Transformer transcription fit only 2/8 per source and later stages stopped at the registered gate. Raw differences motivated a subsequently registered same-data linear diagnostic: withheld-intensity heard-word recognition scored 4/4 per source versus Transformer 1/4 on identical tests. Heard-word information reached the peripheral; the current learning/representation route was implicated, while recalled-content translation remained unreliable. All 312 compared object processes differed, yet 256 yielded identical words; this is a measured distinction, not proof of learned meaning. Same-checkpoint calibration changed 2/12 to 3/12 per source and was not promoted to a default. Conditional ablation and rescue did not run without reliable naming; E50 evidence retained its scope. There were 340 budget-counted source stages/probes and 72.93 recorded compute minutes. Tools, bilingual reports and evidence were preserved. Further work should separate heard, recalled and expressed activity and test observation versus emitted-output boundaries before expanding courses.
